---
description: "Diagnose ambiguity, unclear workflow handoffs and consistency gaps across the existing prototype without implementing changes."
agent: Prototype Change Partner
---

Follow [the prototype agent contract](../agents/prototype-change-partner.agent.md).
Use baseline/diagnostic mode, not implementation mode.

Read `prototype-docs/state.md`, the full baseline/register, decisions, prior
diagnostics and answers. Refresh only stale evidence relevant to this pass.
Diagnose full-prototype coherence and propose a prioritized wrinkle backlog.
Keep observed mismatches, intent questions, test gaps and optional improvements
separate. Link findings to requirements and source evidence.

Write/update `prototype-docs/diagnostics.md` and `prototype-docs/questions.md`,
preserving IDs, previous answers and dispositions. Present the highest-impact
small batch of unanswered intent questions and stop for review.
Do not change app behavior, configuration, tests, production planning, runtime
data or this setup. Do not auto-fix findings or run external/model integrations.
